lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Your name didn’t land at the very top. It settled on the second list—the one fewer people talk about but the one that still opens doors. Regional support. Real help.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You kept it honest. You kept showing up. Maybe you missed a morning, maybe an attendance mark, but the work was yours and it stood.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At home, the news hit softer but deeper. Relief is quieter than applause, and sometimes it feels better.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: On campus, you became the person others ask for notes—not because you were perfect, but because you were consistent. Prestige fades quickly; peace lasts longer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You didn’t win the stage lights. You won something steadier: a path you can keep.
